package.description: Open-source parametric 3D CAD built in Rust.

en-US.description: Open-source parametric 3D CAD built in Rust.
en-US.longDescription: SolidCraft is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Sketch, constrain, extrude, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild. It runs on desktop and web, and can be automated through MCP with solidcraft-cli.
en-US.name: SolidCraft

zh-CN.description: 用纯 Rust 构建的开源参数化三维 CAD。
zh-CN.longDescription: SolidCraft 是一个用纯 Rust 构建的开源参数化三维 CAD 应用。绘制草图、添加约束、拉伸实体，修改参数即可看到时间线重建。它可在桌面与网页运行，并能通过 solidcraft-cli 经 MCP 自动化操作。
